quarterly_data.quarter: X-Energy press release: TRISO-X Completes Vertical Construction of TX-1 Fuel (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TRISO-X completed vertical construction of TX-1, finishing the primary structure of the 214,000-square-foot fuel fabrication facility; work moves to interior utilities, fuel fabrication equipment installation and supporting facilities (Clark Construction Group as contractor). TX-1 is expected to produce approximately 700,000 pebbles a year (5 MTU), fuel for up to 11 Xe-100 reactors; TRISO-X has also started construction of TX-L, a dedicated research and development facility.
quarterly_data.figure: vertical construction complete; TX-L R&D facility construction started
